scope: Independent single-batch saved-pixel-only review of eight original whole desktop/mobile screenshots.

observations: The complete title and printed-page line are separate from the opening prose. Paragraphs occupy a consistent centered column, with clear line and paragraph separation and no visible right-edge clipping.
Figure 147 has white space around the mirror, ray endpoints, axis labels and focal-plane label. Its two model annotations and figure caption are visibly separated from the surrounding prose.

Figure 148 is framed within the text column. The dense ray intersections remain visible, while the outer point labels, mirror ends, model annotations and caption remain inside the saved image without visible label-to-caption overlap.
The numbered ray descriptions and following paragraphs have visibly separated inline mathematical tokens. The final prose and Exercises control do not collide.
limits: The long whole screenshot is displayed at reduced scale; this observation does not establish exact small-subscript glyphs or numerical text-size thresholds.

observations: The lesson title and Exercises suffix fit together on one line, with the printed-page line below rather than overlaid.
The Questions heading and blue rule are separate from three numbered question rows. The longest question stays within the visible column, and the horizontal separators do not intersect the text.
The Back to text control has a readable arrow and label, with clear space between it and the third question. The large remaining blank region contains no visible displaced content.
limits: The saved appearance of the navigation control establishes neither its target nor its response to activation.

observations: The lesson title, Answers heading and top separator are clearly distinct; answer numbers 1, 2 and 3 begin separate blocks with ample clearance.
The first and second answer paragraphs wrap inside the same column, with legible line separation and no visible truncation against either side.

The third answer's numbered ray list contains visually distinct italic mathematical tokens rather than fused words. Wrapped continuation lines and the concluding paragraph remain separated, and the final line has bottom white space.
limits: Only typesetting is judged here; the correctness, completeness and source fidelity of the answers retain their separate existing approvals.

observations: Four question groups are visibly separated by horizontal rules. Long prompts wrap inside the column without covering the option rows.

The square controls in the first and third groups and circular controls in the second and fourth groups occupy a stable left column; option letters are separate from both the control outlines and the option text.
Multi-line option text keeps its continuation indentation, with clear vertical gaps between adjacent options. The last option of the fourth group remains visible above bottom white space.
No visible option text crosses a separator or the right edge of the content column.
limits: Unselected control outlines are visible, but no selected, focused, submitted or feedback state is evidenced.
Choice semantics and answer selection rules are not reassessed.

observations: The title wraps to two lines without colliding with the printed-page line. Prose, bold phrases and inline mathematical tokens wrap inside the side margins with consistent line separation.

Figure 147 fits horizontally: its secondary-axis and focal-plane labels, outer endpoints, mirror and bottom model annotations are visibly contained. The caption has separate white space before the next paragraph.
Figure 148 also fits horizontally. Its mirror ends and outer labels remain inside the image; the central ray cluster is dense but no definite label clipping or annotation overlap is visible.
The four numbered ray descriptions and final paragraphs continue within the narrow column. The Exercises control is fully visible below the final paragraph, with no text laid over it.
limits: Small figure subscripts are not used to certify precise glyph identity or a minimum font size from this long scaled whole image.
Visible containment does not prove horizontal or vertical scrolling behavior.

observations: The lesson title and Exercises suffix occupy two readable lines inside the side margins; the printed-page line remains below them.
The first two question rows are single-line at the saved width, while the third wraps to two lines. Its continuation stays within the question area and does not touch the preceding separator.
The Questions accent rule is distinct from its heading, and the Back to text control is fully framed below the questions with clear whitespace.
limits: The blank lower viewport is not evidence about unseen states or navigation behavior.

observations: The two-line lesson title and Answers heading are separate. Answer numbers and horizontal rules maintain clear block boundaries.
The first two long answer paragraphs reflow inside the side margins; their final lines are visible without text touching the separators.
In the third answer, the inline ray notation is visually distinct from adjoining prose, and numbered items reflow over multiple lines without colliding with the following item.
The concluding paragraph stays within the column, and its final line is followed by visible bottom white space.
limits: This is a static typesetting assessment, not a renewed review of scientific or English-content approvals.

observations: The title wraps to two lines above the Choices heading. All four prompt groups remain inside the narrow content margins and are separated from their options.

Square and circular control outlines, option letters and option text use three visibly separate horizontal positions. Long option continuations retain the text indentation rather than wrapping beneath the controls.
The especially long second-group alternatives retain readable line separation and vertical space between rows; no definite text overlap or right-edge truncation is visible.
The third and fourth groups remain orderly through the last option. The final option text ends above bottom white space rather than being visibly cut by the saved image edge.
limits: The long screenshot is scaled in the viewer, so no exact small-glyph or quantitative font-size certification is made.
The saved control state does not establish tapping, focus, selection, submission, judging or feedback behavior.

findingSummary: No definite visible wrapping, clipping, overlap, mathematical-spacing or figure-framing defect was found in the eight inspected originals. PASS is based on their visible pixels, not on the manifest status or prior non-pixel approvals.

approvalReuse.disposition: Existing approvals are carried forward as instructed, not reopened, regenerated or independently recertified by this pixel-only reviewer.

staticViewLimits: Only the eight original saved images were inspected, once each; no reopens, crops, zooms, derived images or other image-bearing history were used.
A saved viewport or image boundary is an evidence limit, not automatically a broken container. Nothing beyond the recorded surfaces is inferred.
Long whole screenshots can be reduced by the viewer. Precise small glyphs, numerical text sizes, font identity and font-loading success are not certified.
No interaction, judging, keyboard behavior, scrolling, ARIA, complete English accessibility, unseen state or headed acceptance is certified.
Manifest bytes and hashes are preserved as supplied bindings; they were not independently recomputed from image files.
closesReadyScope: This independent saved-pixel-only N71 batch is complete with no definite pixel defect requiring revision. This does not independently authorize ticket closure or replace the separate existing approvals.
